title: EasyDrawers
description: Infinite-storage drawers for every vanilla wood type — break them and keep your stored items, fully compatible with Open Parties and Claims.
body:
# Easy Drawers

**Easy Drawers** adds simple, lightweight storage drawers for every vanilla wood type in Minecraft — store unlimited amounts of a single item per drawer, no more chest spam.

## Features

- **11 wood variants** — Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Pale Oak, Crimson and Warped drawers, matching every vanilla wood type.
- **Infinite single-item storage** — each drawer holds unlimited quantities of one item type, perfect for bulk resources like cobblestone, dirt, or saplings.
- **Quick interactions** — left-click to deposit/withdraw a single item, right-click for stack-based interactions (no GUI needed).
- **Comparator support** — drawers output a redstone signal based on their fill level, just like vanilla storage blocks.
- **Safe to break** — destroying a drawer drops it as an item *with its contents intact*, so you'll never lose your stored items by accident.
- **Claim-friendly** — full compatibility with [Open Parties and Claims](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-parties-and-claims), drawers respect claim permissions like any other protected block.

## How it works

Place a drawer of your chosen wood type, then interact with it to start storing items. Each drawer is tied to a single item type at a time — once it's empty, you can store something else in it. The front face displays the stored item and quantity, so you always know what's inside at a glance.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader
- Works alongside [Open Parties and Claims](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-parties-and-claims) — claimed drawers are protected the same way as vanilla blocks.

## Planned / Ideas

- **Auto-sorting network** — shift-right-click while holding an item to scan nearby blocks and automatically deposit it into a drawer already storing that item. If no matching drawer is found nearby, you'll get a clear message instead.
- **Connectors** — extend the auto-sorting range by linking drawers together through a chain of connector blocks (drawer → connector → connector → ... → drawer), letting you build larger sorting networks across your base.
- **Dye support** — color the drawer's frame using vanilla dyes for better organization and visual customization (experimental, still investigating feasibility).
- **Long-term support** — the mod will be kept up to date with future Minecraft versions, with a 26.2 compatibility update planned soon.
